kebab_example: aliyun agentloop search-context --agent-space my-agent-space --context-store-name my-context-store --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchContext

parameters.help_en: The AgentSpace name. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The context store name. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: The structured filter conditions. The key is the field name, and the value is the expected matching value
parameters.help_zh: 结构化过滤条件，key 为字段名，value 为期望匹配的值
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to apply structured formatting to the returned results
parameters.help_zh: 是否对返回结果做结构化格式化
parameters.name: formatted

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned results (similarity Top-N)
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果数量上限（相似度 Top-N）
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The retrieval query text. Natural language is supported
parameters.help_zh: 检索查询文本，支持自然语言
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The retrieval options that control the retrieval strategy
parameters.help_zh: 检索选项，控制检索策略
parameters.name: retrieval_option

parameters.help_en: The similarity threshold. Results with a similarity score lower than this value are filtered out. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 相似度阈值，低于该值的结果将被过滤，取值范围 0-1
parameters.name: threshold

requestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求

results.description_en: The list of retrieval results, sorted by similarity in descending order
results.description_zh: 检索结果列表，按相似度从高到低排序

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of each field in the search results. The type varies depending on the field
additionalProperties.description_zh: 检索结果各字段的值，类型随字段而定
additionalProperties.title_en: 检索结果各字段的值，类型随字段而定
additionalProperties.title_zh: 检索结果各字段的值，类型随字段而定

items.description_en: A single retrieval result. The structure is aligned with the storage fields of the context store
items.description_zh: 单条检索结果，结构与上下文库存储字段对齐
items.title_en: 单条检索结果，结构与上下文库存储字段对齐
items.title_zh: 单条检索结果，结构与上下文库存储字段对齐

results.title_en: 检索结果列表，按相似度从高到低排序
